messages:
maria (docs): heads-up: opened a small PR to add a compact example for the tool-calling + structured-output section. needs a quick sanity check and a couple link fixes :eyes:
kevin (eng): on it. which languages for SDK snippets do we want? TS only or py + ts?
maria (docs): plz both TS and py. keep the examples minimal — show function call payload, expected JSON schema, and a short parse fallback.
sushil (eng-ml): can we include a tiny schema for optional fields? shows people how to accept a nullable result but still validate shape. something like:
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "task": {"type": "string"},
    "result": {"anyOf": [{"type":"null"}, {"type":"object"}]}
  },
  "required": ["task"]
}
```
agnes (devex): also flag the migration note: older SDKs returned raw strings for tool responses. add a one-liner about using the parse helper in latest SDK or falling back to JSON.parse.
maria (docs): good call. kev — can you paste the TS snippet for calling and parsing? keep it <10 lines.
kevin (eng): sure. paste below:
```ts
const res = await client.callTool({name: 'weather', input: 'sf forecast'});
// server returns structured JSON in `res.output`
const parsed = tryParseJSON(res.output) || {error: 'parse_failed'};
```
kevin (eng): and small helper for tryParseJSON: `function tryParseJSON(s){try{return JSON.parse(s)}catch(e){return null}}`
maria (docs): perfect. sushil — can you add a sentence about guardrails: prefer explicit schema + validator, but allow graceful fallback to a shim when schema mismatch? Example: log mismatch and return a safe default.
sushil (eng-ml): yep. suggested wording: "If the model output doesn't validate against the schema, log the mismatch and use the defined fallback object. This prevents crashes while we investigate quality regressions."
agnes (devex): one more: there are two broken links in the PR (old function-calling RFC and an internal snippet). @docs-bot can you run a quick link-check?
docs-bot: Link-checker: scanning changed files... found 2 broken links: `/rfc/function-calling-v1` and `/snippets/old-tool-sample`.
maria (docs): thanks. I'll replace the RFC link with `/guides/function-calling` and update the snippet to the new path.
kevin (eng): quick question on wording: do we call it "function calling" or "tool calling" in the docs? we have both uses across pages.
maria (docs): use "tool calling" as primary, but keep a parenthetical note the term "function calling" may appear in older guides. add cross-ref.
agnes (devex): nit: add a small table-of-contents entry so readers can jump to "Parsing & Fallbacks". makes it easier for cut-and-paste teams.
maria (docs): ok I'll push an update in ~15m. if no objections, I'll merge after CI passes.
kevin (eng): LGTM once the two links are fixed. :thumbsup:
sushil (eng-ml): one final ask: include a short note about tokenization impact if people store raw JSON in prompts — probably out of scope but a pointer to the optimize section would be helpful.
maria (docs): added a line and linked to `/optimize/batching-and-caching`.
docs-bot: CI: docs linting passed. link-check: ok. spellcheck: flagged `parsingfallbacks` — maybe needs a space.
maria (docs): fixed the typo. merging now. thanks everyone! :rocket:
